notes: A058347_symm: T n k = T k n for T defined by the entry's recurrence (over Z). T = 2^(nk)(2n+2k) - n 2^((n-1)k+1) - k 2^(n(k-1)+1) - 2S, S(n,k) = sum of GF(2)-ranks of all n x k matrices (row recurrence by conditioning on the first row); S symmetric via its column recurrence (one linear_combination) and induction on n+k. T_data: T(2,2), T(2,3), T(3,3) match the data by rfl. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none for the theorem (the recurrence is the entry's formula; the rank interpretation of S is explanation; data agreement beyond the spot checks by certificate/check.py).
